source_reviews.independent_solution: 在很薄的空气裂隙、合适照明且两侧反射光可重合的条件下，同一入射光在冰-空气和空气-冰界面形成两束反射光，额外光程随裂隙厚度和入射角变化，对白光不同频率造成不同增强或减弱，出现彩色闪光。这不是任何裂痕都必然发生，也不要求制造裂痕。冰折射率高于空气：冰向空气反射无pi翻转，空气向冰反射有pi翻转；两反射的相对反射相位为pi，不是增透膜两次均翻转的零差。正入射总相位差=4pi*n_air*h/lambda0+pi；理想反射增强满足2*n_air*h=(m+1/2)*lambda0，减弱满足2*n_air*h=m*lambda0，不能不检查折射率次序便套增透膜四分之一波长相消规则。

mathematics.independent_solution: Fringe displacement records optical-path change: known DeltaL and fringe count N give lambda=DeltaL/N; gas introduces an index-dependent path shift; varying surface gaps produce fringe distortions. A suitable film weakens reflected amplitudes and can improve transmission. A passive nonabsorbing film does not create energy; violet residual reflection does not mean violet-only transmission. True set {A,B,C,E}. Post-freeze comparison: the author's complete set agrees; both language versions preserve these conditions.

option_checks.evidence: For the already optical (not merely mirror displacement) path change DeltaL, N fringe periods give DeltaL=N*lambda. DeltaL is optical path, so the frozen DeltaL=N*lambda check avoids confusing mirror travel with round-trip path.

Thickness sets reflected relative phase and index affects reflected amplitudes. Suitable choices reduce reflected intensity and the multiply reflected stray-light contribution; in a low-loss optical system this improves transmitted imaging, without guaranteeing perfect transmission. Post-freeze derivation check: Author phase from thickness plus amplitude from index supports reducing reflection/stray light, not perfect all-colour cancellation or zero real losses.

Replacing reference gas along one path of length L changes optical path by L*(n_test-n_ref), producing N=L*(n_test-n_ref)/lambda fringe periods. With known geometry/reference this measures the gas index. Post-freeze derivation check: Author gas-dependent optical path shifts relative phase/fringes, supporting index measurement when other quantities are controlled.

For the passive nonabsorbing ideal film, R+T=1; cancellation lowers R and raises T only up to 1. It cannot create light or make transmitted energy greater than incident energy. Post-freeze derivation check: Author mistaken identification of greater useful transmission with creation of light generates D's excess-energy claim, violating the frozen R+T=1 lossless relation.

The reference plane and test surface bound a gap whose local optical round-trip path varies with surface height. Reflected fringe positions therefore reveal local path differences and departures from the reference surface, enabling a surface-quality test. Post-freeze derivation check: Author local gap thickness/path and changed or bent fringes support surface inspection; no missing wavelength is used to manufacture a numeric precision.

Pale violet is the residual reflected spectral mixture after stronger green-reflection reduction. Reflection and transmission are different outputs; reduced green reflection generally increases green transmission in the low-loss model, contradicting violet-only filtering. Post-freeze derivation check: Author substitution of residual reflected colour for transmitted spectrum generates F's violet-only claim; it is contradicted by green reflection being suppressed rather than green transmission excluded.
